title: Cycles fix (mechanical, compile-gated)
summary: Plans, compile-gates and (with --apply) writes the mechanical fix of one circular uses group, verified against the predicted cycles output
intro: cycles --fix makes the edits a --plan playbook describes: a dry run that builds and stages the result, or --apply with .BCK backups, an in-place build, rollback on a compile error or a build timeout (no time limit by default; `--build-timeout <s>`; progress shown; Cancel stands down, rolls back, exit 1 cancelled -- rolled back; kill after 90 s) and a re-indexed verify. It moves shared types into a leaf unit, inverts a call through a pointer, or extracts an interface. A cycle it cannot cut is refused with one line per reason, never half-written. --rsvars names the Studio build environment.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint cycles --db <file.sqlite> [--edges] [--causes] [--plan [--project <X.dproj>]] [--f2047 [--unit <stem>]] [--fix --project <X.dproj> [--stall-exit-min <minutes>] [--cycle <n> | --unit <stem>] [--part a|b|all] [--apply] [--no-backup] [--no-reindex] [--no-compile] [--shadow-out <dir>] [--rsvars <path>] [--build-timeout <s>]] [--ctor-wide] [--format json|text] [--library-db <lib.sqlite>] [--platform win32|win64] [--rules-dir <dir>] (circular unit deps; --fix = the mechanical cycle fix for ONE group (the first mechanical one, or --cycle / --unit; text names the groups it did not plan): dry run = verdict + cycle-fix/1 JSON, no source written, stages the result in a shadow tree (default C:\TEMP\draglint_cyclefix_<pid>\, deleted at exit unless a message of the run cites a file in it, then kept and named on stderr; --shadow-out names another, never deleted) and builds the project (msbuild /p:Config=Debug for --platform, default the project's active platform, else win32) unless --no-compile, exit 0 mechanical / 1 refused / 2 error; --apply writes it (.BCK<n> backups unless --no-backup), builds, re-indexes unless --no-reindex and re-runs cycles against the prediction, exit 0 written and verified (or written with --no-reindex, unverified) / 1 refused, rolled back after a compile error or build timeout, or written but not verified / 2 error: a write or build failed part-way (rolled back, project not changed, or the rollback failure is named) or bad flags; a rollback restores the sources, not the DCUs the failed build wrote: rebuild after a rollback; --apply --no-compile is exit 2; --rsvars <path> = the Studio build environment the compile gate calls (default: the Studio the registry or BDS names; forwarded to every --part all iteration; a missing file is exit 2); --build-timeout <s> = whole seconds one build may take (default 0 = no limit; forwarded to every --part all iteration; anything but a whole number >= 0 is exit 2); a stand-down request (drag-lint shutdown --db <db>, or the IDE's Cancel) kills the build, rolls an --apply back and exits 1 ("cancelled -- rolled back"); --part all needs --apply, refuses --no-reindex; --plan = mechanical refactoring playbook: moves, uses edits, new-unit text, checklist + predicted output, and a "Fix it" block per group (the exact --fix dry-run and --apply commands; --project names the project in them, else <your.dproj>); --library-db / --platform name the platform library --plan reads class ancestry from (default: the manifest's library for the build platform: --platform, else the --project's active platform, else win32; --library-db none = no library); --rules-dir is forwarded to every --part all iteration; --format json --causes adds per-group fix{available,part,dry_run,apply,edges[],reason,followup} and edges[] with each edge's surface: members read, writes, construction, class methods, routine + signature types)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Fix Circular Uses Mechanically (dry run)...
steps: Save all files (the engine plans and compiles from disk)
drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Fix Circular Uses Mechanically (dry run)...
Read the verdict in the report: mechanical, or refused with one line per refusal

surfaces.path: View > Tool Windows > drag-lint > Uses & Deps > This project -- Circular uses (cycles --fix)
steps: View > Tool Windows > drag-lint, tab Uses & Deps
In the Circular uses section tick one group
Dry run to see the verdict, then Apply and answer Yes to write, build and verify it

steps: In the drag-lint Structure window, Diagnostics tree, right-click a circular-uses finding
Apply cycle fix... (runs the dry run, asks you to confirm, then --apply)
